📚 لماذا الضريبة \"تصاعدية\" وليست نسبة ث: 📚 Why is the tax “progressive” rather than a flat rate?
معنى نظام الشرائح التصاعدية أن كل شريحة: A progressive bracket system means each slice of your income is multiplied by its own rate only, not that all your income is multiplied by the highest rate it reaches. For example, if your taxable income is 12,000 dinars, that does not mean all 12,000 is taxed at 15%; the opposite: the first 5,000 is taxed at 5%, the next 5,000 at 10%, and only the remaining 2,000 at 15%. This is exactly what this page's calculation function (`calcTax`) does, walking bracket by bracket and stopping at each limit.
هذا النظام مستخدم في معظم دول العالم (ول: This system is used in most countries of the world (not only Jordan) because it balances fair tax collection with not burdening low earners; the first dinar you earn is taxed at the lowest possible rate (5%), and only income above certain limits reaches higher rates.

كم الإعفاء الشخصي والعائلي؟: How much are the personal and family exemptions?
9000 دينار إعفاء شخصي لكل مكلف، و9000 دي: 9000 dinars personal exemption per taxpayer, and an additional 9000 dinars family exemption for the married or the provider. In addition, documented expenses (medical, education, housing) can be deducted as follows: 1000 dinars for the taxpayer, an additional 1000 dinars for the spouse (if any), and up to 1000 dinars per dependent child with a maximum of 3 children — with an overall maximum of 23000 dinars for all exemptions combined, under Article 9 of Income Tax Law No. 34 of 2014 and its amendments.
